text_block_list.text:
It seems Super Creek is going to look for everyday sneakers
with Narita Taishin.

I was asked to help pick something out,
and since I had the chance, I decided to tag along.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Hey... why are you following me?
I want to go by myself.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, don't say that.
I was just wanting to see it myself.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
For roommate's sake,
since we have the chance, why don't we go together?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
...Then why is your Trainer here,
when you aren't even roommates?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
If I'm choosing running shoes, I'd love your opinion.
You're so dependable after all, Trainer♪

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: ...Whatever.

The shopping mall was crowded.
While making our way toward our destination
amidst the bustle—

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Oh? Taishin-chan is...
choice_data_list: Did I get separated from the others?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Oh my, whatever shall I do?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Taishin-chan...
I should've held onto your hand tighter.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
"They must be feeling so lonely and anxious.
We have to find them quickly."
choice_data_list: Let's have them paged over the lost-child broadcast.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Yes, then I shall head over that way.
Let us meet back here later.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Taishin-chan,
I'll find you right away, okay?
Lightly weaving through the crowd, Super Creek ran off to look for Narita Taishin.
Thirty minutes later—

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Haaah... I'm so glad we found it~.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: To think they'd actually come looking for me...

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
I'm not a kid.
Even if I got lost, you could've just left me alone—

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Haa, haa... phew...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Ah, I'm sorry.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Maybe because I was paying too much attention to everyone around me, my breathing got more ragged than usual.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: I'm all right now. Come, shall we go?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Haaaah... Geez.
Alright, alright, I just won't leave your side, okay? Sheesh.
Watching Narita Taishin trail behind with a defeated look, Super Creek smiled gently, seeming to sense something.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Oh, that's a wonderful idea!
Let's go ask right away!
(Ding-dong-dang-dong♪)

text_block_list.name: PA Announcement
text_block_list.text:
"'Thank you very much for visiting us today.
We have a lost child announcement
for all guests in the store.'"

text_block_list.name: PA Announcement
text_block_list.text:
"Narita Taishin-chan, wearing her Tracen Academy uniform
with her short hair—"

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
They made an announcement for us too,
so with this, I'm sure Taishin-chan will—

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Wait, what?!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Taishin-chan!
Thank goodness, I found you~

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
"Thank goodness" my foot!!
What was that?! Who're you calling a lost child?!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
I'm not lost!!
I was just pretending to be separated!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: My! Was that so?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, you little rascal~.
You mustn't do things like that anymore, okay?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: No, it's not a prank or anything!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Yes, please be good now.
That's right, let's hold hands and go together~

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Just listen to what I'm saying!!

Having her hand grabbed without any say in the matter,
Narita Taishin slumped her shoulders in resignation.

Seeing that, Super Creek smiled,
as if she had learned something.
